title: Hue Garden
tagline: A colour or a shape. One line at a time.
taglineZh: 颜色或形状，连成一条线。

lines.en: A colour, or a shape. One line at a time.
lines.zh: 颜色，或形状。连成一条线。

lines.en: Hue Garden. A courtyard of glazed tiles.
lines.zh: 彩庭。一座铺满釉面瓷砖的庭院。

lines.en: One colour, new shapes. Or one shape, new colours.
lines.zh: 同色不同形，或者同形不同色。

lines.en: Six in a row blooms for six more points.
Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a planning Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到会计划的挑战。

lines.en: One screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi. The host keeps the deal.
lines.zh: 一块屏幕，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。主机保留牌局。

lines.en: Undo, hints, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 悔棋、提示、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Hue Garden. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 彩庭。离线、无账号、无广告。
